notes.title: New Update: MODIFIERS!
notes.notes:
We've finally implemented gameplay modifiers!
You can change now bullet size and speed, make every wall bouncy or increase your ammunition.
There is just to many stuff to tell, so let's go and see it yourself and set the modifiers just like you want to create your own crazy version of Retimed :D

May the bullet time be with you!
Best,
Team Maniax

notes.title: Patchnotes version 1.14.2 and 1.14.3
notes.notes:
In this Update we added Christmas skins for our Characters and fixed some bugs related to getting achievements.

Here is the complete list of changes:

NewAdded Christmas skins for our Characters. Those will be present in every game mode except for quick play. Quick play will follow in a few days.
Added a ForceMouseCursorVisible launch option that, when set to true will always show the mouse cursor.


FixesFixed a bug in the "One shot one kill" achievement that accidentally counted missed shots of the enemies as a fail
Fixed "Happytown expert" and "Happytown master" achievements not getting properly triggered. Those will get retroactively applied.
Fixed online tournament matches not getting counted towards the "Virtuoso" achievement.

notes.title: Patchnotes version 1.14.1
notes.notes:
In this Patch we fixed a bug that caused the "pick and ban" phase in the team tournament to not work properly. Additionally we made some small improvement and fixes.

Here is the complete list of changes:

NewAdded a "Texture Quality" launch option to set the textures to a lower resolution in order to circumvent an issue on some graphics card that can't handle large textures. In order to activate this feature go into the properties of the game, click on the Set Launch Options... button and enter "TextureQuality=X" where X is a number that tells how many times the resolution of one texture is halved. So 0 = default, 1 = half, 2 = quarter etc.


ImprovementsReplaced the operating system specific mouse cursor with a larger Retimed specific cursor


FixesFixed pick and ban not working correctly for team tournament
Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the in game cross hair to be black.
Fixed player names with non Latin characters not being properly displayed in the game end screen
Fixed mouse cursor being displayed during game

New ambient sounds for Rubberforrest, Industrial district, Ice and both Bintain levels added 
"Best of x" options added for tournament mode


Improvements

Ice level music improvements
Performance improvements
Dash visual improved (dashing will now look more consistent across devices)
GIF encoding quality improved
Various sound effect improved
Removed slowmotion bubble in character selection screen
UI navigation scrolling added
Round timer now starts after the countdown has finished
Small ingame UI improvements
Small endscreen UI improvements

More gameplay setting values added


Fixes

Fixed a bug that would allow a sliding player to dash upwards while on the ground
Fixed freeze on level start if four player starts in the same team

notes.title: Patchnotes version 0.7.4
notes.notes:
New

Added a moving platform to Bintain02 level


Improvements

Players own icicles will no longer kill and block them
Bullets will only get damaged when destroying an icicle. This allows a player to destroy two icicles at once.
Improved player death burst animation
Yeti platform visual improved


Fixes

Fixed audio SFX slider not working for some sound effects
Fixed graphics settings menu not responding to mouse
Fixed ammunition fight no correctly choosing the nearest player
Fixed command line arguments not being case-sensitive
Fixed a rare bug where player can be unable to jump after he has jumped two times without leaving the ground
Fixed bug where player are able to kill each other in team selection screen
Fixed icicle replay bug
Fixed a bug where icicles would stick in the ground on low frame rates

notes.title: Patchnotes version 0.7.3
notes.notes:
New

Settings menu added
Tournament mode added: This mode limits the number of players to two, allows you to choose the same character twice and only shows the maps that are in the official SMGL map pool, in the future this list will expand
TournamentMode and ExhibitionMode launch options added: When the game is launched with one of these options enabled, the exit button and other features are removed in order to make it easier to showcase the game
Added resume promt: Now all players have to be ready before the game can be resumed


Improvements

Character duck and slide height balances
Animation lag reduction
Rubberforest upper left corner collider has now a more useful angle
Added ability to dash upwards when character stands on the ground
Small Bintain02 Level improvements
Small Replay improvements
SFX improvements
Frame rate is now caped to 400 FPS


Fixes

Fixed bug where on some machines the replay was black
